It’s a Wonderful Life (1946)

Dec 18 & 19   IT'S A WONDERFUL LIFE (1946) Our Annual Showing of a Holiday Favorite
Not a success at the box office, this film was great director Frank Capra’s favorite film.  It’s been named by the American Film Institute as one of the top American films of all time —and the most inspirational.  It’s not about religion, but every time we show this movie, an angel gets his wings (come see the film to find out why).  Don’t miss it.  Jimmy Stewart, Donna Reed, Lionel Barrymore. 130 min. Dir. Frank Capra PG IMDB 8.6
Film at 7:30 
Free live music at 7 pm: Friday: Outfielders: “Old-time fiddle, mandolin & banjo tunes” Saturday: Shelburne Falls old-time jam session
